title: (RHBA-2018:2260) rh-eclipse47 bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated rh-eclipse47 packages are now available as a part of Red Hat Developer Tools for Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Workstation)|1|x86_64
Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Server)|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The rh-eclipse47 packages include Eclipse 4.7, an integrated development environment (IDE), which is based on the Eclipse Foundation's Oxygen release train.

This update fixes the following bug: 

* Prior to this update, the rh-eclipse47-eclipse-linuxtools package did not perform an appropriate check on the installed version of the Guava libraries. Consequently, if a mismatch between the Guava version required by linuxtools and the version installed occurred, Eclipse Docker Tools failed to function correctly. The linuxtools subpackage has been updated to perform a more stringent check, which fixes the described problem. (BZ#1600964)

Users of rh-eclipse47 are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.

For instructions on how to use rh-eclipse47, see Using Eclipse linked from the References section.
